test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

Can you __assembly__ the television using the manual?
solution: Here the correct answer is **Assemble**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • In the above-given sentence, '**assemble**' will be used. • It is so because** 'after a modal verb (here, can), base form of the verb should be used'.** • **For Examples:- ** • We** can** **eat **leftovers for dinner. • They** can run** fast. • Base form of the given word is '**assemble**'. • Thus, the corect answer is** Option 4.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] Hinglish__** • ऊपर दिए गए वाक्य में '**assemble**' का प्रयोग होगा। • ऐसा इसलिए है क्योंकि** 'एक modal verb के बाद **(यहाँ, can)**, क्रिया के आधार रूप का उपयोग किया जाना चाहिए'।** • **उदाहरण के लिए:-** • We can eat leftovers for dinner. • They can run fast. • दिए गए शब्द का आधार रूप '**assemble**' है। • इस प्रकार, सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4** है। 3c:Tbf1, The correct answer is '**Extreme**'.
